thread:
Sam: quick ping — opened a tiny runtime PR that tweaks the batcher prefetch threshold to avoid a small KV cache thrash under load. would love a fast look, targetting tomorrow's patch release. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821 :eyes:
Nina: hm can you summarize perf impact? worried about tail latency regressions when batch sizes are small
Sam: good call. local perf microbench (synthetic chat workload, 128-token prompts):
```
before: p50=11.9ms p95=28.6ms p99=85.3ms
after:  p50=11.7ms p95=26.2ms p99=62.1ms
```
Sam: no increase in p50, p95 improved a bit, p99 improved significantly in this run. these are on A100 dev—will repro on T4 shortly
Olga: what's the change to KV TTL / eviction logic? last time a small ttl bump caused more misses than expected
Sam: not touching TTL. this just delays prefetch by ~10ms when batcher decides it won't fill a batch quickly. fallback path unchanged. added a safety metric so we can rollback if miss rate rises
Lee: i'll skim now. tagging @Mike since he owns batcher heuristics historically
Mike: looking — quick glance: logic looks fine, one nit in comment but doesn't block. add a tiny unit test for the early-return path?
Sam: will add unit test and a short e2e run. thanks!
ci-bot: CI / unit-tests passed for PR #4821 (linux, macos) — 6/6 checks green :white_check_mark:
Nina: can we get a canary on dedicated for 1h before release? would like to watch kv miss rate and token latency
Sam: yep planning a 1h canary tomorrow at 09:00 PT. will route 5% traffic to this variant and collect prefix-hit / miss metrics
Lee: i've got a 09:00 PT slot open to do the rollout, i can monitor dashboards and abort if things look off
Mike: LGTM. if Sam adds the unit test and the canary dashboard looks stable, feel free to merge in the morning. :+1:
Sam: added unit test and note in PR, scheduled canary with rollout config in the PR description. tagging for merge: @Lee to do the deploy window, @Mike final approval if no issues observed
Olga: thanks — leaving a quick comment about log-level to help debug if we need to abort
Sam: perfect. appreciate the fast eyes, team. i'll post the canary outcome after 09:15 PT tomorrow
ci-bot: deploy-sim check: canary config validated (5% variant)
Sam: merging will wait for Mike to ack post-canary. if no reply by 10:30 PT and metrics look stable @Lee you have permission to merge?
Mike: yes, give the green after 09:30 PT if p99 stays <= baseline*1.2 and miss-rate delta < 0.5%
Sam: copy that. thanks everyone :rocket:
